bayts.text: And accept my life through You, O Appreciative, O You Who raise gratitude from me to Him.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have made room for me, with good pleasure, by (the Name) "the All-Embracing" (Al-Wāsiʿ), and for the Gardens You have been for me with abundance.
You have led to me the obligatory and the recommended together, and the permitted: He has gathered both for me.
Bless with a blessing that leads generosity to me, O You Who drove the vast army toward others than me,
with a peace that sends toward others than me what You do not love for me, O You Who perpetuate my good,
upon him who conveyed to me good things with which he made life and the abodes clear for me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me writing with recitation, and perpetuate sweetness for me in both,
and in other than them, of what You make lawful for me, O You Who make lawful, Who have guarded my person from the shameful.
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Intimate, O our Beloved!
You have commanded us to bless our master Muḥammad, the vessel of the heights,
and to greet him with peace; so I say, for Your noble Countenance: accept the saying from me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
To You be eulogy, praise and thanks together, for him who has gathered Your grace for me.
Bless with a blessing that fills the heaven and the earth, O You Who led growth to me,
with a peace that rises to the Throne and fills the Footstool, O Lord of the outspread earth,
and may both bring joy into the heart of the Prophet, the gladness of every near one and stranger,
upon the chosen Prophet, Muḥammad, his Family, his Companions and the praisers.
And make, by his mighty standing, my speech illumined, O Possessor of loftiness and bounty.
And make it a service without faults, O Knower of the manifest and the hidden.
And grant me Your being for me in it and in other than it, in all that comes from me.
And make clear for me my creeds, my word, my deeds and my character, O my Strength.
You have come to meet me with reward and recompense toward Your Gardens, and with what is right.
And make, by the standing of the Chosen, my life the gladness of the ḥadīth and the verses.
And spread over me the blessings of (the sūra) al-Fātiḥa, and make my pens openers (fātiḥa) of hidden things.
And spread over me the blessings of (the sūra) al-Baqara, O You Who turn Your Saqar (the Fire, Qurʾān 74:26) toward others than me.
And spread over me the blessings of (the sūra) Āl ʿImrān, in the present and the final outcome.
And grant me, by the sūra an-Nisāʾ (Women), well-being of morning and evening.
And grant me the opening and make the sciences easy for me, and increase me from You in knowledge, O All-Knowing (Qurʾān 20:114).
You have granted me of Your mighty grace what led me to gratitude with well-ordered verses.
You have given me refuge in You from Satan; You have been for me in passing and in the lands.
You opened for me the gate of good things, closing the gate of evils, and it closed before me.
You have split open (baqarta) for me the secret of the beneficial sciences, O Sender of the best guidance, O Raiser of it.
You have sheltered me with You, O Generous, O Everlasting, Whose gratitude I long for.
You have banished Iblīs and what allies with him toward others than me, perpetually, O Allah.
O Allah, bless forever and grant peace upon Your Prophet, the lamp of the learned,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant us through him the straight path, the path of those from whom whoever turns to others is sick (cf. Qurʾān 1:6-7).
And grant us faith and Islām, and the finest excellence (iḥsān) and surrender.
And grant us soundness of hearts from the faults of the self, O Nourisher Who has guaranteed (it).
And grant us protection, O Bestower, O You to Whom belong the returning and the going.
And grant us certainty and steadfastness, and make arrival and repose everlasting.
And bless, O All-Merciful, and grant peace upon the Arab Prophet, the banner,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make the letters of these ordered verses draw the great wishes.
And make them all the loftiest blessings, and guide my stillnesses and movements.
And bless, O Most Merciful, and grant peace upon the Messenger possessed of distinctions, the ladder,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my life gladness for him, O Everlasting Who have spared me harm.
And write for him, in all that comes from me, what gladdens him, O You Who guard my sides.
O Allah, bless and grant peace at every moment upon Your Beloved, chief of the righteous,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
